_comment: The most of each guide that may be a row saying it does not know what
is on, as a share of its rows: 'لا توجد مباراة مجدولة', the tabii PPV
notice, a channel repeating its own name, an operator's blurb about
itself. A countdown naming the next fixture is NOT counted — see
STANDIN_TITLE in health_check.py for why that distinction is the whole
This exists because ON Sport spent days at 86% — its source, FilGoal's
RSS, had been shut off and every run said so in a warning nobody read.
The guide kept publishing, kept passing every check, and the only thing
that noticed was a person looking at a television.
Each ceiling sits above what that guide measured while known to be
working, with room for a quiet week, and below what it measures when
blind. ON Sport is the worked example: 36% fixed, 86% blind, held at 70.
Raising one is a decision to make deliberately, with the measurement
that justifies it — not a way to quiet a red run.
_note_working: Alwan, Fajer and Thmanyah are confirmed working by their owner at these levels. Their ceilings sit above where they measured, not at some ideal.
_note_onsport: A weak signal for this guide, and the file should say so rather than pretend. Correctly read, ON Sport carries four or five fixtures a day and its remaining hours are honest ignorance: 82%. Blind, it read 86%. Four points is not a threshold anybody can act on, so the ceiling is set at 90 to stop it crying wolf, and the real protection for this guide is the collapse guard in build_all_epg.py and a second independent publisher. The 36% measured earlier today was not a healthier guide — it was the mis-mapping that put Liverpool, Al Wasl and Tottenham on an Egyptian channel, and inflated fixtures inflate the ratio too.
